name: Google Workspace
description: Browse Google Drive, read and edit Docs, Sheets and Slides with your agent, and open files in Atrium Browser.

actions.name: skill
actions.description: Read the bundled agent guide with authorization, read/edit/verify workflows and examples.

actions.name: interface
actions.description: Discover Google Workspace actions, authorization boundaries and API references.

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Refresh the visible file list.

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the visible file list. Use drive_list for structured, paginated results.

actions.name: create
actions.description: Create a native Google file; returns file and editor_url, opened:false.

actions.name: open_link
actions.description: Prepare a Google document link in the app without opening a browser.

params.url: Google Docs, Sheets or Slides URL

actions.name: open
actions.description: Open an accessible file in an Atrium Browser window; returns window_id.

actions.name: drive_list
actions.description: Return up to 50 accessible files/folders and nextPageToken. Metadata-only access does not grant content access.

actions.name: drive_get
actions.description: Read file metadata, parents, canEdit and isAppAuthorized.

actions.name: drive_create_folder
actions.description: Create a folder in Drive.

actions.name: drive_copy_file
actions.description: Copy an accessible file. Preserves its contents; returns the new file ID.

actions.name: drive_update_file
actions.description: Rename, describe, move, trash or restore an authorized file. No permanent deletion or permission changes.

params.name: Optional new name
params.description: Optional description, empty string clears it
params.add_parents: Optional array of destination folder IDs
params.remove_parents: Optional array of current parent IDs
params.trashed: Optional boolean; true moves to Trash, false restores

actions.name: docs_get
actions.description: Read structured Google Docs content, including all document tabs and revisionId.

params.fields: Optional Google partial-response field mask; revisionId is always included

actions.name: docs_batch_update
actions.description: Edit text, tables or formatting with official Docs requests. Read first and read back after writing.

params.required_revision_id: Required revisionId from docs_get; rejects stale edits
params.requests: Array of 1–100 Google Docs API Request objects, max 1 MB

actions.name: sheets_get
actions.description: Read spreadsheet metadata, sheets and named ranges. Grid data is off by default.

actions.name: sheets_values_get
actions.description: Read cell values in an exact A1 range.

actions.name: sheets_values_update
actions.description: Write an exact A1 range. RAW is default; USER_ENTERED enables formulas. No atomic revision guard: read target first and verify afterward.

params.values: 2D rows of strings/numbers/booleans/null, max 10000 cells and 1 MB; null skips, empty string clears

actions.name: sheets_batch_update
actions.description: Edit sheets, formatting, tables or charts using official Sheets requests. Read target first and verify afterward.

params.requests: Array of 1–100 Google Sheets API Request objects, max 1 MB

actions.name: slides_get
actions.description: Read presentation structure, slides, element IDs and revisionId.

params.fields: Optional Google partial-response field mask; revisionId is always included

actions.name: slides_page_get
actions.description: Read one slide/page and its elements.

actions.name: slides_batch_update
actions.description: Edit slides, shapes, text and formatting using official Slides requests. Read first and read back after writing.

params.required_revision_id: Required revisionId from slides_get; rejects stale edits
params.requests: Array of 1–100 Google Slides API Request objects, max 1 MB

notes: Shell-hosted web app. Agent actions use official Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides APIs with the connected user’s drive.file grant. Optional drive.metadata.readonly adds full file metadata only. OAuth tokens stay in browser memory. User sign-in and Picker selection are required; no credential or arbitrary HTTP action is exposed. Human editing opens Google in Atrium Browser with its own website login. No automatic local-file upload or permission changes.
